subject: Data description entry
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB504, with kb/Work PB831; the figurative admission is the kb/Work PB828 adjudication). The implied PICTURE is now SYNTHESIZED, by the SynthesizeImpliedPictures bind pass, which runs over the COMPOSITION forest between ExpandTypes and UsageInheritancePass. It builds the character-string SR9 spells out - X(length) / 1(length) / N(length), the length being CobolLiteral.Decode's character count, which is the standard's own per-format length (two hexadecimal digits per alphanumeric character, four per national character, four boolean characters per hexadecimal digit) - and hands it to the ONE PictureAnalyzer.Analyze call a WRITTEN clause takes, with the entry's own usage and SIGN clause and explicitUsage = 'this entry wrote a USAGE clause'. From that point the item is indistinguishable from one whose source wrote the clause, so 13.18.60.4 GR1 group inheritance, the 13.18.60.3 SR3/SR5/SR12/SR20 screens, the VALUE initializer and the emitter all apply through their existing single sites - 13.18.60.3 SR13 a) and SR20 are written for exactly this, naming the 'explicit or IMPLICIT picture character-string'. The FIGURATIVE spellings ride the same synthesis: 8.3.3.1 makes a figurative constant a literal, 8.3.3.6.4 GR3 b) gives a non-ALL figurative length one and GR3 c) gives ALL literal-1 the length of literal-1, GR1 selects the national representation in a national context and GR4 the boolean one for the ZERO format. SR9's exclusions are enforced by exclusion, not by carve-out: a zero-length literal, a numeric literal, the class-pointer figurative NULL and the Format-2 (table) VALUE all fall to SR-13.16.3-8's rejection. Edition gate: the construct row value-implied-picture-2002 rejects below 2002 (COBOL0900) - COBOL-85 required a PICTURE for every elementary item bar an index data item and the subject of a RENAMES clause. Measured: `01 A VALUE "HELLO".` prints [HELLO] and LENGTH 5; `01 R. 05 A VALUE "HELLO". 05 B PIC X(3) VALUE "XYZ".` prints [HELLOXYZ]; `01 G VALUE ALL "AB".` prints [AB] LENGTH 2 where it used to print A silently (kb/Work PB831).
